title: Wave 2 — empty-req multi-host walls (human only)
policy: After wave2 auto-classify (REMOVE_ALL / PRIMARY / MULTI_KEEP), these names stay walls — do not auto-home or auto-remove.
Each wall needs a human answer before catalog surgery: single home, multi-ok hosts + requiredRegions, global remove, or rewrite into split rows.
hosts = contested dual/multi set the human is choosing among (may differ from current catalog if an interim home was guessed).
Do not edit data/research/catalog.json from this file alone.

classifiedElsewhere.autoRemove: global / skip outfits / jewelry tele / Slayer Learn / aquarium / thaler / nimble / silverhawk / etc. — scripts/wave2-clamp-dedupe.mjs REMOVE_ALL

notes: Hosts are the contested set for the human answer, not necessarily live catalog hosts after interim auto-homes.
If a name was already single-homed in catalog but detail still argues the other side (Brooch, POP, Holy wrench, Deadliest Catch, Family Crest), it stays on this wall until you confirm.

Intentional multi-req tool chains already in MULTI_KEEP (Imcando, Earth and Song, Life and Death, Orthen, GOTE base, Mattock of Time and Space, etc.) are not walls unless listed above as mega-chain ban reappearances.
After answers: apply via a dedicated rulings script; do not re-open auto PRIMARY for these names.
